title: Apple's Next Device.
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: Big tech bundling into 'One' subscriptions drives high-margin ARR; smart strategy.

calls.reason: Smart-home hub, Duo and Apple One/AppleCare One drive ARR; he models 20% annual EPS growth vs ~9.9% consensus, implying $495-500.
calls.quote: I look at this as about a $495 to $500 stock, which I know sounds crazy because the stock has already done quite well

notes: No date stated in transcript; Apple smart-home launch said to be Oct 13. Kevin owns AAPL; sent buy alert at 310-315 during Apple event.
